description: This header file defines replacement functions for sscanf that are locale-independent, primarily for parsing floating point numbers from strings in a consistent manner. It includes a C function prototype and a C++ templated wrapper, meant to be used as drop-in replacements for sscanf in projects that require locale-independent parsing.
